messages:
Lee (Support): Escalation: account Meridian Labs failing onboarding ingest for batched CSVs >11MB. Logged SUP-6122. Renewal in 3 weeks.
Nora (CS): Thanks Lee. Is this reproducible? Can we get customer to hold off sending new batches? I'll coordinate an immediate enablement slot.
Lee (Support): Repro steps attached in ticket. Error: `502 upstream read timeout` when combined batch size >11MB. We restarted workers; issue persists.
Vik (Infra): Observed spike at 2024-06-08T08:40Z on connection queue. Temporary throttle added to batch endpoint. Will enable verbose parser logs.
Nora (CS): Comms plan: 1) Ask customer to chunk uploads under 11MB (short-term) 2) 45m troubleshooting call today to collect sample payloads and SDK logs 3) Mark renewal "At risk" pending call 4) Eng to provide ETA for fix. Owners: Dana = comms, Vik = infra lead, Lee = support follow-ups, Nora = CS lead, Rita = AM.
Dana (CS Ops): Drafted email and invite, including checklist: SDK version, sample payload, origin (cloud/on-prem), retry headers, and proxy in path.
Rita (AM): I'll join call and prep renewal contingency notes. Notifying finance.
Lee (Support): Customer accepted call for 15:30 PT.
Nora (CS): @AlertBot please open incident INC-8305 and link SUP-6122. Set severity P2 and request ENG triage within 24h.
AlertBot: INC-8305 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-8305  severity=P2  owner=Vik.
Vik (Infra): I'll collect traces and try a streaming parser patch. ETA RCA: 6 hours.
Dana (CS Ops): Sent comms to customer with invite, CC'd Rita + Nora.
Nora (CS): CRM: renewal flagged At Risk. After troubleshooting we'll reassess and update renewal status.
